[Agricultural economics · quantitative analysis · policy]{.eyebrow}

I am an MSc Agricultural Economics student at Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin. My coursework combines econometrics, quantitative methods, economic modelling, agricultural markets and public policy. I want to use data-driven analysis on agricultural, environmental and climate-policy questions.

Before my MSc, I completed a BSc in Agriculture at Agriculture and Forestry University in Nepal (2025). There I focused on agricultural economics, production systems and natural resource management, and collected field data for applied agricultural research.

## Interests

My main interest is the economics of climate and environmental policy, especially in the European Union:

- EU climate policy instruments: the Emissions Trading System (ETS), the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM), the Carbon Removals and Carbon Farming certification framework (CRCF), and the Deforestation Regulation (EUDR)
- The EU Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) and its environmental dimension
- Environmental and resource economics, carbon pricing and carbon markets
- Economic evaluation of regulations and policy impact assessment

## Career direction

I am working towards a career as an economic and policy analyst in the climate and environmental field. I am particularly interested in climate-policy consultancies, economic consulting firms, research institutes and international organisations. I am currently looking for working-student and internship opportunities in these areas.
